messages.subject: Project Quartz — Series A term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Alice,

Great to confirm we're proceeding. Please find our proposed term sheet for the £10m Series A (Ravensworth £8m as lead, Aldridge £2m). Subject to contract and IC, but we're very keen.

We've asked Hargrove & Associates to act for us. Happy to talk through any points.

Victor
Managing Partner, Ravensworth Ventures LLP

messages.subject: RE: Project Quartz — Series A term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Alice,

We've reviewed the term sheet — overall it's market for a round of this size. The points worth pushing on: (1) the option pool is being set pre-money so the dilution sits with you and the existing holders — that's normal but worth understanding; (2) the founder warranty cap and de minimis/basket thresholds; (3) the scope of investor consent matters (the £250k disposal threshold is a little low); and (4) the exclusivity period runs to 8 May.

Marked-up term sheet attached with our comments. None of it is a dealbreaker. Shall we set up a call with Victor's team for Thursday?

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0012
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
